up: Return all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2203023. A molecule is considered reported if it is linked to that document via the compound_records table (i.e., compound_records.doc_id matches the doc_id from docs where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2203023'). For each distinct molecule, provide its ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). If a molecule lacks a SMILES entry, return NULL for that column. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2203023';
